summary: Hapuppy's free tier grants a one-time 200K-credit signup bonus for its OpenAI-compatible API gateway (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek and others — 105+ models total). The free tier is limited to basic models at 10 RPM and the grant never resets or refills. One-time credit packs ($9.99+) unlock all models at 100 RPM and never expire.
claim_steps: Dashboard → API Keys → Create Key (key format sk-hapuppy-…).
Call https://beta.hapuppy.com/v1 with any OpenAI-compatible client; the 200K signup credits are granted once.
